titles.title: ghCreateLabel: creates without force and answers true; an existing label counts as created; false for any other gh failure
ghCreateLabel asks no approval: it is common, not destructive, so a push with no client attached is not denied
ghCreateIssue: the ref from the printed url; an unrecognized url throws; a gh failure throws
ghCreateIssueTyped: typed, then untyped once only when the type is rejected; any other failure throws without a second POST
ghLinkSubIssue, ghGetIssueId: the sub-issue link and the REST id, with a malformed ref refused
ghGetIssueBody, ghEditIssueBody, ghComment, ghCloseIssue, ghAttachMilestone: the issue tools with the repo and the number
ghListIssueComments: every comment ascending by time and id, with since; a bad line throws and is never read as no comments
ghPostCommentReturningId: the new comment id
ghGetIssueState: lower-case state with the label names
ghFindIssueByLabels and its Strict form: the first issue; none is undefined; a gh failure is undefined only for the non-strict form
ghListIssuesByLabelsStrict and ghListIssuesByTitleTokenStrict: ascending refs; the title filter keeps the token and the token followed by a dash only
ghEnsureMilestone: best effort, a gh failure (including already exists) is swallowed
queryTasks and listMyOpenTasks: the search string, the page size cap, the cursor, the task projection and the current login
every row, on a gh failure, gives its old failure: a thrown GhCommandError of the right kind, or its best-effort result; void rows resolve to undefined on success
a denial is thrown, never swallowed, in every kind of row (best effort or not)

ghTokenScopes: the scopes from the header, an absent header is an empty list, a gh failure is ok:false with the old reason
ghCurrentLogin: the login; a gh failure throws; an empty answer throws
ghListOrgIssueTypes: the names; [] only when gh fails
ghCreateOrgIssueType: true; false only when gh fails; a denial is thrown
ghCreateProject: number and url; null only when gh fails; a denial is thrown

ghAddProjectSingleSelectField: true; false only when gh fails; a denial is thrown
ghListRepoIssueUrls: the urls up to the limit; [] only when gh fails
ghAddProjectItem: true; false only when gh fails; a denial is thrown

registry-table.test.ts: one case per organisation, project, scope, login and url row, with null, false and [] only for gh failures
ghAuthOk: ok when gh answers for the signed-in user; ok:false with the old reason when it does not; a missing gh is ok:false too
gitOriginOwnerRepo: owner and repo from https and ssh origins; null with no origin, a non-GitHub origin or a non-repository
